description_for_human: Black-box security scans for vibe-coded apps. Free lite scan; paid continuous full scans after ownership verification.
description_for_model: VibeTesting Agent runs black-box security probes (headers, TLS, CSP, DNS, secrets, exposure, SEO, a11y) against a public URL. Use the lite scan for a quick public check, or authenticated API/MCP for full owned-project scans. Always require the user to confirm they own or have permission to scan the target.
